description: Government social scheme application facilitation: a partner publishes schemes as resources and its facilitation service as offers; the applicant (or an assisted-channel agent) discovers a scheme, gets a provisional eligibility pre-check at select, gives consent at init and confirm, and follows the application through government decision and disbursement with status.

policyRequirements.note: Offers on this flow SHOULD carry a registered policy IRI for each required category (offerAttributes.cancellationPolicy and offerAttributes.grievanceSlaPolicy).
